decisions.rationale: Names a single specific form of muscular dystrophy (X-linked Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy, linked to the emerin gene), so it is a Specific Disease mention. The minimum span includes the 'X-linked' qualifier because it defines this particular form.

decisions.rationale: 'Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy' is the disease name studied in the families and is linked to one defined condition, so it is annotated as a Specific Disease. This duplicate mention is annotated separately, as required.

decisions.rationale: 'EMD' is the abbreviation for Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy given in parentheses. Abbreviation and long form are annotated as separate mentions, so the short form is a Specific Disease mention.
